example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে কালান্তক আসছে, সবাই তৈরি হয়ে নাও।
এই কালান্তকের মতো ঝড়ে ফসল নষ্ট হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: A kalantak is coming to the village; everyone get ready.
The crops were destroyed in a storm like a kalantak.
history: Refers to fierce maritime storms common in Bengal's coastal regions, evoking imagery of destructive cyclones.
note: This idiom draws from Bengali experiences with seasonal cyclones, symbolizing imminent catastrophe.
